A.behavior: Only memory holds unsubmitted input. Failure stays in the editor. Detail supports pull-to-refresh. Explicit migration removes obsolete table.

B.behavior: Label always above field; tertiary placeholder inside. Secondary/focus/error roles explicit, including disabled and multiline.

C.behavior: Foreground service, cancel/progress/retry, HTTPS entry and redirect allowlist, re-fetch API metadata, SHA-256 before installation, permission return, system installer, download-page fallback.

D.behavior: Measured floating capsule, 20dp side margins, system navigation inset +16dp bottom, hard shadow. Equivalent scroll content padding. Hidden during IME to expose inputs.

E.behavior: Restaurant/account tabs, centered nav-add creates restaurant from either tab. Legacy tab falls back. add-visit and visit-history remain reachable.

limitations: No local Gradle or emulator execution, as instructed.
